name: Matte vinyl 0.09 mm — experimental thresholds
notes:
EXPERIMENTAL. Not a production profile and never to become one: its thresholds are below what any datasheet claims, and a project validated against it can be cut by hand and nothing more.

It exists because the physical proof protocol needs printable files for the cases the engine is right to refuse. t2, t4 and t6 are supposed to FAIL — that is what they are for — and a failing project exports nothing. This profile is how the operator gets geometry to put under a knife without editing the profile that production uses. The thresholds below are set from the fixture geometry, not from physics: they say "do not block the export", nothing more.

Every artefact produced with this profile carries code matte-vinyl-090-exp, so it cannot be mistaken for a production run. If a number learned from the bench confirms a threshold, it goes into matte-vinyl-090 as a new version, never here.
